Sun.name: Sun (Surya)
Sun.themes: Leadership, vitality, self-expression, ego, power, confidence
Sun.spiritual: Represents the Atman (soul) and divine consciousness. The source of life and spiritual illumination.

Moon.name: Moon (Chandra)
Moon.themes: Nurturing, intuition, feelings, mental peace, receptivity, imagination
Moon.spiritual: Represents the mind and emotional body. Gateway to inner peace and devotion.

Mars.name: Mars (Mangal)
Mars.themes: Warrior nature, action, leadership, conflict, passion, drive
Mars.spiritual: Represents willpower and the ability to overcome obstacles. Spiritual warrior energy.

Mercury.name: Mercury (Budha)
Mercury.themes: Logic, speech, commerce, learning, adaptability, wit
Mercury.spiritual: Represents discriminative intelligence and the power of the word. Bridge between worlds.

Jupiter.name: Jupiter (Guru)
Jupiter.themes: Expansion, knowledge, teaching, fortune, optimism, grace
Jupiter.spiritual: Represents the spiritual teacher and divine grace. Path to higher knowledge and dharma.

Venus.name: Venus (Shukra)
Venus.themes: Beauty, harmony, relationships, pleasure, creativity, refinement
Venus.spiritual: Represents devotion and the path of bhakti. Divine love and aesthetic beauty.

Saturn.name: Saturn (Shani)
Saturn.themes: Limitation, responsibility, hard work, patience, detachment, time
Saturn.spiritual: Represents karmic lessons and spiritual maturity. The great teacher through challenges.

Rahu.name: Rahu (North Node)
Rahu.themes: Ambition, obsession, foreign influences, unconventional paths, material desires
Rahu.spiritual: Represents worldly attachments and the path of material experience. Catalyst for growth.

Ketu.name: Ketu (South Node)
Ketu.themes: Detachment, mysticism, liberation, past karma, spiritual insight, renunciation
Ketu.spiritual: Represents spiritual liberation and past life wisdom. Path to moksha and enlightenment.
